bioconda.name: sprinter
bioconda.summary: Single-cell Proliferation Rate Inference in Non-homogeneous Tumours through Evolutionary Routes (SPRINTER)
bioconda.description: SPRINTER is an algorithm that uses single-cell whole-genome DNA sequencing data to enable the accurate identification of actively replicating cells in both the S and G2 phases of the cell cycle and their assignment to distinct tumour clones, thus providing a proxy to estimate clone-specific proliferation rates.
